Berkshire paid $1.3 billion for its Coca-Cola shares. In 2025, Coke paid it $816 million.

Berkshire Hathaway started buying Coca-Cola in 1988 and built up to 400 million shares, at a total cost of $1,299 million (about $3.25 a share). Its 2025 annual report shows $816 million of Coca-Cola dividends in 2025: about 63% of the original cost, in one year. Coca-Cola raised its dividend again in February 2026, its 64th annual increase in a row. Dividends can be cut, and past results don't guarantee future ones.

What company would you guess pays out the most cash to its owners?
